name: adv_domain_untagged_vs_liquid_rejected
source:
// Untagged fluid meeting an explicit domain$ = liquid line.
Source     SRC(fluid$ = Water, mdot = 1.0, P = 300000, T = 320)
LiquidSink LS()
connect(SRC.out, LS.in)
m = LS.mdot

error.message: connect(src.out, ls.in): cannot connect a 'fluid' line (src.out) to a 'liquid' line (ls.in). Thermofluid ('fluid'), liquid ('liquid'), two-phase ('twophase'), pneumatic ('gas'), hydraulic ('oil') and humid-air ('moistair') are incompatible fluid connector types; couple them only through a heat exchanger.
